_about: One release entry in the release format, written by scripts/release-runs.py from real runs of two builds. The commands, output lines, exit codes, result files and builds come from the raw record in site/changelog/logs/; whole lines are cut to fit by the fixture, no line is edited. Only label, headline, lead, next.note and film are written by hand. Whether the release is tagged, and its date, come from git when the site is built.
label: Behavior change
headline: sweep now continues the sorting you already started

lead.text: is already there, sweep 0.5.5 moves one or two matching files into it and exits with code 0. Version 0.5.4 left those 2 files where they were and exited with code 1.

output: 2 files matched no group and were left where they are

note.text: A new folder still needs 3 or more files. No flag needed. To put the 2 files back, run

runs_note: Each ran the same commands on a fresh copy of one synthetic folder, inbox: a Documents folder with 3 PDFs, and 2 new PDFs loose next to it. Output is shortened to fit by cutting whole lines. Every command ran in a sandbox that let it write only inside its scratch folder and could not run /usr/bin/security.
